gloss: sudden braking; slamming on the brakes

definitions.explanation: Braking hard and suddenly, as when a driver slams on the brakes or a train makes an emergency stop. Also used figuratively for a sudden halt, for example in the economy.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけた。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The train came to a sudden stop.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}して→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とっさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んだ→踏む：01197_fumu⟧。
examples.english: A child ran out into the road, so the driver instantly stamped on the brakes.

notes:
Made of ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden) + ⟦ブレーキ→ブレーキ：00022_bureeki⟧ (brake). On trains an announcement such as {急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ warns passengers to hold on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to brake suddenly
- {急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: to stamp on the brakes
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{急|きゅう}ブレーキ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: the economy comes to a sudden halt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急停車|きゅうていしゃ}: sudden stop (of a vehicle)
- {急発進|きゅうはっしん}: sudden start
